1-1.name: First Delivery
1-1.cargo: A birthday card for the toucan twins
1-1.thanks: Best birthday ever! We squawked for an hour.
1-1.hint: Tap to flap. Fly through the stars.

1-2.name: Star Streak
1-2.cargo: Star charts for the sloth stargazer
1-2.thanks: No rush, I said. You rushed. Thank you.
1-2.hint: Chain stars for 3×; three perfect gates earn a magnet.

1-3.name: Bat Patrol
1-3.thanks: Now even the shy ones are glowing.
1-3.hint: Shoot. Tap Shoot to knock out bats.

1-4.name: Carnival Skies
1-4.cargo: Feather boas for the carnival parade
1-4.thanks: The parade starts now. You made it!

1-5.name: Express Post
1-5.cargo: A rush invitation for the drum captain
1-5.thanks: So fast my hat blew off. Marvellous!
1-5.hint: Sprint smashes bats and surges ahead.

1-6.name: Temple Steps
1-6.cargo: Cocoa beans for the temple cooks
1-6.thanks: Hot chocolate for the whole temple!

1-7.name: Sunrise Roost
1-7.cargo: A sundial for the dawn keeper

1-8.name: Baron Bat
1-8.cargo: A final notice for Baron Bat
1-8.thanks: Fine. FINE. Take your noisy route.
1-8.bossLine: This route is my roost now, little courier!

2-1.name: Beetle Road
2-1.cargo: Laurel wreaths for the chariot racers
2-1.thanks: We shall wear them at every race!
2-1.hint: Beetles spit seeds. Shoot the seeds down.

2-2.name: Sealed Gates
2-2.cargo: A new chisel for the statue carver
2-2.thanks: At last I can finish his nose.
2-2.hint: Hold Shoot for a big rock that breaks stone.

2-3.name: Wildfire Run
2-3.cargo: Water buckets for the fire brigade
2-3.thanks: Just in time. Truly, JUST in time.
2-3.hint: Fly through the gold rings to outrun the fire!

2-4.name: Nile Switchbacks
2-4.cargo: A book of new riddles for the Sphinx

2-5.name: Skyfall
2-5.cargo: A telescope for the pyramid astronomer
2-5.thanks: Now I can see the meteors coming!

2-6.name: Lantern Bazaar
2-6.cargo: Lamp oil for the lantern sellers
2-6.thanks: The bazaar glows again. A thousand thanks!

2-7.name: The Long Caravan
2-7.cargo: Water flasks for the long caravan

2-8.name: Spitter King
2-8.cargo: A stop-brewing order for the Spitter King
2-8.thanks: Bah. It was very nearly ink.
2-8.bossLine: Every letter on my road goes in the brew!

3-1.name: Moth Light
3-1.cargo: Light bulbs for the theatre marquee
3-1.thanks: The show goes on! Front row for you.
3-1.hint: Moths fire fans of three. Slip between them.

3-2.name: Wheels in the Rain
3-2.thanks: Dry feathers at last. You’re a hero.
3-2.hint: Alley pigeons swoop in to grab stars. Shoot them first!
3-2.bossLine: Nobody flies till the bread cart is found!

3-3.name: Steam Alley
3-3.cargo: Hot pretzels for the night-shift cabbies
3-3.thanks: Still warm! How fast do you fly?
3-3.hint: Vents hiss, then burst. Hop the hot ones, ride the soft ones.

3-4.name: Storm Warning
3-4.cargo: A weather vane for the tallest tower
3-4.thanks: It spins! It points! It’s perfect.
3-4.hint: Stay out of the light. Shoot the lamp when it opens! No Sprint here.
3-4.bossLine: Hold still! Nobody ever stays in the light.
